responsibility: Declares small shared text-input helpers used by the gm2 ISO text and numeric readers. It provides procedures to skip leading whitespace on a channel and predicates that summarize whether another character may be consumed without crossing a line mark and whether the current read result already indicates end-of-line or end-of-input.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is only the helper interface, declaring SkipSpaces, CharAvailable, and EofOrEoln for reuse by text and numeric readers; the same-stem .mod file supplies the underlying IOChan-based tests and whitespace skipping code.
